name: How do I know bathtub installation won’t turn into a bigger job than I wanted?
description: Get a written scope and estimate before work starts so you know what is included. That is the best way to avoid surprise add-ons or a bigger project than expect

mainEntity.name: How do I know bathtub installation won’t turn into a bigger job than I wanted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many homeowners worry that a tub installation will turn into a bigger project than expected, especially if they have had bad contractor experiences before. The best way to reduce that risk is to ask for a clear scope, a written estimate, and a walkthrough of what is included before work begins. That makes it easier to compare bids and avoid surprises.
